text:
After each producer pass, when the change list holds a Rust file, have Athena's own code run `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` on the work tree. Put this in the same place as the format step in crates/athena-core/src/run/format.rs and producer.rs, run it through run_check, and keep the same deadline, kill-switch and redaction handling. If clippy fails, send the work back to the producer once with the clippy output through the existing send-back path, then run clippy again. If it still fails, hand the job to the configured clippy check as now, so the gate is not relaxed. Acceptance: (1) a test where a producer diff trips clippy's field_reassign_with_default lint shows the producer gets the clippy output and the repaired tree passes; (2) a clean diff goes on with no extra pass; (3) a diff with no Rust file skips the step; (4) a test fails if the clippy step is taken out of the producer loop. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Clippy lint in new code is caught only at the final verdict; no code step runs clippy before verification
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: crates/athena-core/src/run/format.rs, producer.rs, CHANGELOG.md
